Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    pat=[(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=0 and gi[r][c]!=5]
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==5]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pat]; cs=[p[1] for p in pat]
    rmin,cmin=min(rs),min(cs)
    copied=[(r,c,go[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if go[r][c]!=0 and go[r][c]!=5 and not any((r,c)==p[:2] for p in pat)]
    outcells=set(pat); outcells.update(copied)

    comps=[]

    used=set()
    for p in copied:
        if (p[0],p[1]) in seen: continue
        comp=set()
        q=[p]; seen.add(p)
        while q:
            a=q.pop(); comp.add(a)
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                b=(a[0]+dr,a[1]+dc)
                if b in seen: continue
                seen.add(b); q.append(b)
        for qcell in comp: seen.discard(qcell)
        comps.append(comp)
    print('comps sizes',[len(c) for c in comps])
    for comp in comps:

        rr0,rr1=min(rs_),max(rs_); cc0,cc1=min(cs_),max(cs_)
        rel=[((r-rr0),(c-cc0),v) for r,c,v in sorted(comp)]
        # which seed is nearest to top-left?

        print('copy bbox',rr0,rr1,cc0,cc1,'nearby seeds',near)

def analyze(g):

    holes=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(hr) for cc in range(hc) if not any(rr==q and cc==t for q,t,_ in rel)]

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    comps=comps_8(g)
    tmpl=max((c for c in comps if any(g[a][b]==5 for a,b in c)),key=len)

        dr=sr-h_abs[0]; dc=sc-h_abs[1]
        for a,b in tmpl:
            rr,cc=a+dr,b+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
                val=g[a][b] if include5 else None
                if include5: out[rr][cc]=val
                else: out[rr][cc]=(out[rr][cc] if val==5 else val) if val is not None else None
                if val==5: pass
        # clear seed
        out[sr][sc]=0

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g)
    tcomp=max(cs,key=len)
    cells=[(a,b,g[a][b]) for a,b in tcomp if g[a][b]!=5]
    hpos=min(((a,b) for a,b in tcomp if g[a][b]==5))
    p=[r[:] for r in g]
    for s in seeds if False else [(list(c)[0] for c in cs if c is not tcomp)]: pass
    seeps=[list(c)[0] for c in cs if c is not tcomp]
    for s in seeps:
        off_r=s[0]-hpos[0]; off_c=s[1]-hpos[1]
        for a,b,v in cells:
            rr=a+off_r; cc=b+off_c
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and p[rr][cc]==0:
                p[rr][cc]=v
    for s in seeps: p[s[0]][s[1]]=0
    return p
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
